name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash MiaAI-Lab
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 双节点 TP=2 DSpark 服务：Anemll 分发镜像、FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机、NVFP4 DS-MLA、1M 上下文。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-dspark:
    image: ${DSPARK_VLLM_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/dspark-vllm-gx10-mia:v0.1.1-hotfix2}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8888}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "64gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
      - ${HOME}/.cache/vllm-cache:/cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      - ${DSPARK_TMP_HOST:-${HOME}/.cache/dspark-tmp}:/tmp
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载，避免启动时访问 HF
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-0}"
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      DSPARK_MODEL: "${DSPARK_MODEL:-deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731}"
      DSPARK_REVISION: "${DSPARK_REVISION:-}"
      SERVED_MODEL_NAME: "${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-deepseek-v4-flash-0731}"
      DSPARK_SERVE_PORT: "${VLLM_PORT:-8888}"  # API 端口仅作 --port 传入；不再导出 VLLM_PORT，避免 vLLM 内部端口从 8888 起扫
      MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}"
      MAX_NUM_SEQS: "${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}"
      MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS: "${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}"
      LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD: "${LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD:-1024}"
      GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: "${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.835}"
      MTP_NUM_TOKENS: "${MTP_NUM_TOKENS:-5}"
      DEFAULT_THINKING: "${DEFAULT_THINKING:-max}"
      DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD: "${DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD:-probabilistic}"
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # JIT 编译缓存持久化（HF 卷，容器重建不丢；镜像入口脚本 + vLLM 运行时消费）
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/triton-cache
      TILELANG_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/tilelang-cache
      B12X_CUTE_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/b12x-cute-cache
      DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/deep-gemm
      VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL: "${VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL:-4096}"
      VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB: "${VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB:-256}"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "${VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}"
      VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1}"
      # 热修复开关（镜像内 bake 的 Mia 入口脚本消费，fail-closed）
      DSPARK_SKIP_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SKIP_ISSUE22_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_ISSUE22_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SKIP_SUPPRESS_STOPS_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_SUPPRESS_STOPS_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING: "${DSPARK_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING:-1}"
      DSPARK_MAX_INFLIGHT_PREFILLS: "${DSPARK_MAX_INFLIGHT_PREFILLS:-1}"
      DSPARK_ISSUE43_SCHED_DIAG: "${DSPARK_ISSUE43_SCHED_DIAG:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE31_GPU_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE31_GPU_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ASSISTANT_FINAL_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ASSISTANT_FINAL_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE136_XGRAMMAR_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE136_XGRAMMAR_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE138_RESPONSES_HISTORY_COMPAT: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE138_RESPONSES_HISTORY_COMPAT:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE141_SPARSE_MLA_CHUNK: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE141_SPARSE_MLA_CHUNK:-0}"
      DSPARK_API_KEYS: "${DSPARK_API_KEYS:-}"
      # 分布式 / NCCL（Fireworks 自动填充 MASTER_ADDR / NODE_RANK / HEADLESS / VLLM_HOST_IP / NCCL_*）
      MASTER_ADDR: "${MASTER_ADDR}"
      MASTER_PORT: "${MASTER_PORT:-25000}"
      NODES_TOTAL: "${NODES_TOTAL:-2}"
      NODE_RANK: "${NODE_RANK}"
      HEADLESS: "${HEADLESS:-}"
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      TP_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${TP_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "${NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS:-}"
      NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL: "${NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL:-}"
      NCCL_NET_GDR_READ: "${NCCL_NET_GDR_READ:-}"
      NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE: "${NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE:-}"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "1"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: "${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_121a}"
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "${FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK:-1}"
      FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE: "${FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE:-/cache/huggingface/flashinfer}"
      TORCH_FR_BUFFER_SIZE: "${TORCH_FR_BUFFER_SIZE:-2000}"
      TORCH_NCCL_DUMP_ON_TIMEOUT: "${TORCH_NCCL_DUMP_ON_TIMEOUT:-1}"
      TORCH_NCCL_ENABLE_MONITORING: "${TORCH_NCCL_ENABLE_MONITORING:-1}"
      TORCH_FR_DUMP_TEMP_FILE: "${TORCH_FR_DUMP_TEMP_FILE:-/cache/huggingface/nccl-fr/comm_lib_trace_rank_}"
      TORCH_NCCL_DEBUG_INFO_PIPE_FILE: "${TORCH_NCCL_DEBUG_INFO_PIPE_FILE:-/tmp/fr_dump_pipe_}"
      VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER: "${VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: "${VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH:-0}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE:-1}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS:-0}"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: "${PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF:-expandable_segments:True}"
    # 无 command/entrypoint 覆盖：镜像内 /opt/dspark/entrypoint.sh 应用热修复后 exec vllm serve

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: Mia 热修复烘焙镜像（已内置完整 fail-closed 热修复链）
variables.help_en: Mia hotfix-baked image (full fail-closed hotfix chain included)

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: 从已下载模型中选择（控制平面下载后分发到各节点缓存）
variables.help_en: Pick from downloaded models (control plane downloads and distributes)

variables.label: vLLM API 端口
variables.help: 仅用于 API 服务端口（serve --port）；vLLM 内部端口已与 VLLM_PORT 环境变量解耦（随机分配），不再触发端口占用扫描日志
variables.help_en: API server port only (serve --port); decoupled from the VLLM_PORT env var so vLLM internal ports allocate ephemerally (no port-scan warnings)

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 文本利用率默认 0.835（与 Mia 配方默认一致）；显存紧张或图形捕获 OOM 时降至 ~0.80
variables.help_en: Text-util default 0.835 (matches the Mia recipe); lower toward ~0.80 if graph capture OOMs

variables.label: DSpark 投机 token 数
variables.help: 必须 ≥ checkpoint 的 dspark_block_size(5)：k<5 会静默截断草稿块，解码吞吐下降
variables.help_en: Must be ≥ checkpoint dspark_block_size(5): k<5 silently truncates draft blocks, lowering throughput

variables.label: 长 prefill 阈值（token）
variables.help: 超过该 prefill token 量则分块，防止长 prefill 挤占 decode 通道（Mia #27）
variables.help_en: Prefills above this count are chunked, keeping decode lanes fed (Mia #27)

variables.label: Prefix-cache 保留间隔
variables.help: SWA prefix-cache 检查点间隔（Mia #26）；默认 4096，仅在调试命中率时调整
variables.help_en: SWA prefix-cache checkpoint spacing (Mia #26); default 4096, tune only when debugging cache hits

variables.label: 默认思考模式
variables.help: 默认 max（与 Mia 配方一致）；off 不生成思考（最快）；low/high/max 开启思考并控制 reasoning effort。注意 max 推理很长，需给足 max_tokens
variables.help_en: Default max (matches the Mia recipe); off: no thinking; low/high/max: thinking with reasoning effort. max reasoning is long - size max_tokens accordingly

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: 如 rocep1s0f0

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: 如 enp1s0f0np0

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析

variables.label: 官方 0731 revision
variables.help: 留空（默认）= 入口脚本自动解析本地 HF 缓存中最新快照的 commit sha，离线可加载；显式设置时必须是实际分发快照的真实 commit，否则离线会 LocalEntryNotFoundError
variables.help_en: Empty (default) = entrypoint auto-resolves the newest cached snapshot sha so offline load works; if set, it must be the exact distributed commit or offline load fails with LocalEntryNotFoundError

variables.label: 跳过 v0.27 perf 回移植
variables.help_en: 1 = skip the six v0.27 perf backport hotfixes

variables.label: 跳过 #22 长上下文修复
variables.help: 1 = 跳过 nvfp4_ds_mla 长上下文解码修复（不推荐）
variables.help_en: 1 = skip the nvfp4_ds_mla long-context decode fix (not recommended)

variables.label: 跳过 stop-stops 修复
variables.help: 1 = 不应用 suppress-stops-in-reasoning 补丁（客户端 stop 可能在思考中触发）
variables.help_en: 1 = do not apply the suppress-stops-in-reasoning patch

variables.label: 抑制思考中的 stop
variables.help: 1（默认）= 客户端 stop 字符串在思考阶段保持休眠，#响应 后才生效
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = client stop strings stay dormant inside thinking

variables.label: 并发 in-flight prefill 上限
variables.help: #27 热修复：并发分块 prefill 数（1-3，默认 1）。上游 #154 实测 2 会放大混合流量公平性带宽（3.72–5.14x vs 1 的 1.68–2.04x），1 为安全默认；2-3 需自行压测后显式开启
variables.help_en: #27 hotfix: concurrent chunked prefills (1-3, default 1). Upstream #154 measured 2 widening the mixed-traffic fairness spread (3.72-5.14x vs 1.68-2.04x at 1); 1 is the safe default, 2-3 are explicit operator opt-ins

variables.label: #43 调度诊断日志
variables.help: 1 = 每步输出调度行（scheduled prefill/decode）用于诊断
variables.help_en: 1 = one scheduler line per step in the vLLM log (diagnostics)

variables.label: 启用 thinking_token_budget
variables.help: 1 = 应用 GPU thinking_token_budget 热修复（默认 stock V2，请求发该字段会 400）
variables.help_en: 1 = apply the GPU thinking_token_budget hotfix (stock V2 rejects the field with 400)

variables.label: 启用 assistant-final 热修复
variables.help: 1 = 消息以 assistant 结尾时补生成头（#52），默认 stock 渲染
variables.help_en: 1 = append a generation header for assistant-final requests (#52); default stock

variables.label: 启用 XGrammar 终止修复
variables.help: 1 = 应用上游 vLLM #52805 XGrammar 终止回移植（#136，源锁定 fail-closed）；默认 0 不改任何字节
variables.help_en: 1 = apply the upstream vLLM #52805 XGrammar termination backport (#136, source-locked fail-closed); default 0 changes no bytes

variables.label: 启用 Responses 历史回放兼容
variables.help: 1 = 兼容缺少顶层 type 的 assistant output_text 单元素回放（#138，仅缺省补全，严格校验其余输入）；默认 0 保持 stock 校验
variables.help_en: 1 = accept type-less singleton assistant output_text replay only (#138, minimal coercion, everything else stays strict); default 0 keeps stock validation

variables.label: 启用 sparse-MLA 64 行分块
variables.help: 1 = 对超长 sparse-MLA decode 按固定 64 行分块（#141，随机 TP=2 卡死 workaround，非根因修复）；默认 0 不改任何字节
variables.help_en: 1 = chunk oversized sparse-MLA decode calls to fixed 64-row views (#141 stochastic TP=2 stall workaround, not a root-cause fix); default 0 changes no bytes

variables.label: 多 Key API 认证
variables.help: 空格分隔的 key 列表，开启 OpenAI 端点认证（之一即可）；留空 = 无认证；与 VLLM_API_KEY 同时设置会启动失败
variables.help_en: Space-separated API keys (any one authorizes); empty = no auth; mutually exclusive with VLLM_API_KEY

description_en: 2-node TP=2 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash: Anemll distribution image, FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculation, NVFP4 DS-MLA, 1M context.
